name: Mobile theme
format:
<style>



* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

:root {
  
  --shd-bg: #0b1420;
  
  --shd-bg-2: #0e1a26;
  --shd-surface: #16263c;
  --shd-card: #243a54;
  
  --shd-accent: #fa6f63;
  --shd-accent-2: #764ba2;
  
  --shd-on-accent: #0b1420;
  
  --shd-accent-text: #ff9a91;
  --shd-text: #eef3f8;
  
  --shd-muted: #9fb0c6;
  
  --shd-text-dim: #95a5b8;
  --shd-ok: #2ecc71;
  --shd-warn: #f1c40f;
  
  --shd-err: #ff8a8a;  
  
  --shd-critical: #c62828;      
  --shd-warning: var(--shd-warn);
  --shd-info: #00acc1;           
  --shd-alert-ink: var(--shd-bg); 
  --shd-alert-padding: 12px;
  --shd-alert-gap: 12px;
  --shd-alert-fs: 1rem;          
  --shd-alert-fs-strong: 1.2rem; 
  --shd-alert-border-w: 2px;
  --shd-alert-glow: 0 0 15px rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.5);
  --shd-touch-target: 44px;   
  --shd-radius: 10px;

  
  --nr-dashboard-pageBackgroundColor:         var(--shd-bg);
  --nr-dashboard-pageSidebarBackgroundColor:  var(--shd-surface);
  --nr-dashboard-pageTitlebarBackgroundColor: var(--shd-surface);
  --nr-dashboard-groupBackgroundColor:        var(--shd-card);
  --nr-dashboard-groupBorderColor:            var(--shd-card);
  --nr-dashboard-groupTextColor:              var(--shd-accent-text);
  --nr-dashboard-widgetBackgroundColor:       var(--shd-card);
  --nr-dashboard-widgetBgndColor:             var(--shd-card);
  --nr-dashboard-widgetBorderColor:           var(--shd-card);
  --nr-dashboard-widgetColor:                 var(--shd-accent-text);
  --nr-dashboard-widgetTextColor:             var(--shd-text);
}

html { font-size: 16px; }

body {
  
  background-color: var(--shd-bg-effective, var(--shd-bg));
  color: var(--shd-text);
  transition: background-color 0.8s ease;
  font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;   
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;            
  overflow-x: hidden;                         
}


.status-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--shd-accent), var(--shd-accent-2));
  color: #fff;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
}

.status-bar .status-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.status-dot.ok      { background: var(--shd-ok); }
.status-dot.warning { background: var(--shd-warn); }
.status-dot.error   { background: var(--shd-err); }



.alert-ok {
  background: var(--shd-card);
  color: var(--shd-text);
  font-size: var(--shd-alert-fs);
  padding: var(--shd-alert-padding);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: var(--shd-alert-border-w) solid var(--shd-ok);
  margin-bottom: var(--shd-alert-gap);
  text-align: center;
}
.alert-info {
  background: var(--shd-info);
  color: var(--shd-alert-ink);
  font-size: var(--shd-alert-fs);
  padding: var(--shd-alert-padding);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: var(--shd-alert-border-w) solid var(--shd-alert-ink);
  margin-bottom: var(--shd-alert-gap);
  text-align: center;
}
.alert-warning {
  background: var(--shd-warning);
  color: var(--shd-alert-ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--shd-alert-fs-strong);
  padding: var(--shd-alert-padding);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: var(--shd-alert-border-w) solid var(--shd-alert-ink);
  margin-bottom: var(--shd-alert-gap);
  text-align: center;
}
.alert-critical {
  background: var(--shd-critical);
  color: var(--shd-text);
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: var(--shd-alert-fs-strong);
  padding: var(--shd-alert-padding);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: var(--shd-alert-border-w) solid var(--shd-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shd-alert-glow);
  animation: pulse 1.5s infinite;
  margin-bottom: var(--shd-alert-gap);
  z-index: 10;
  text-align: center;
}

body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template .alert-critical {
  display: block !important;
}



.nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
  min-height: var(--shd-touch-target);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  margin: 0;
}
.nr-dashboard-cardtitle .nr-dashboard-cardcarat {
  min-width: var(--shd-touch-target);
  min-height: var(--shd-touch-target);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.ui_tab {
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--shd-accent);
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  overflow-x: auto;             
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.ui_tab::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.ui_tab .tab-link {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--shd-text-dim);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  min-height: var(--shd-touch-target);   
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.ui_tab .tab-link.active {
  color: var(--shd-text);
  border-bottom-color: var(--shd-accent);
}


.ui_card, .ui_group {
  background: var(--shd-card);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  padding: 16px;
  margin: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.ui_row {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;          
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ui_row > * { flex: 1 1 auto; }



.mdc-button,
.ui_button,
.ui_toggle,
button {
  min-height: var(--shd-touch-target);
  min-width: var(--shd-touch-target);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-size: 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;  
}

.ui_switch .mdc-switch,
.ui_toggle {
  transform-origin: left center;
}

.ui_slider input[type="range"] {
  height: 44px;                 
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--shd-accent);
}


.status-ok      { color: var(--shd-ok); }
.status-warning { color: var(--shd-warn); }
.status-error   { color: var(--shd-err); }


.ui_table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; }
.ui_table th, .ui_table td {
  padding: 10px 8px;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}


@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50%      { opacity: 0.7; }
}
.pulse { animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }




@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .ui_row { flex-direction: row; }
  .ui_card, .ui_group { max-width: 480px; }
}


@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .ui_row { flex-direction: column; }
  .ui_card, .ui_group { width: 100%; margin: 8px 0; }
}


@media (max-width: 900px) {
  html { font-size: 15px; }
  .ui_table th, .ui_table td { padding: 8px 6px; font-size: 13px; }
  .status-bar { padding: 10px 12px; }
}


@media (max-width: 600px) {
  html { font-size: 14px; }
  .ui_row { flex-direction: column; }
  .ui_table th, .ui_table td { padding: 6px 4px; font-size: 12px; }
  .ui_card, .ui_group { padding: 12px; margin: 8px; }
  .ui_tab .tab-link { padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
  .status-bar { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
}


@media (max-width: 380px) {
  html { font-size: 13px; }
  .ui_tab .tab-link { padding: 10px 10px; }
}



.shd-embed {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 240px;
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  overflow: hidden;              
  background: var(--shd-card);
}
.shd-grafana-frame {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 240px;
  border: 0;                     
  background: transparent;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}


@media (max-height: 480px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .status-bar { position: static; padding: 6px 12px; }
  .ui_card, .ui_group { margin: 6px; padding: 10px; }
}


@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
  .pulse { animation: none; }
}


body.shd-bg-animated,
.ui_card.shd-bg-animated,
.ui_group.shd-bg-animated {
  transition: background-color 0.8s ease, color 0.8s ease;
}


@media print {
  body { background: #fff; color: #000; }
  .status-bar, .ui_tab { display: none; }
}


.shd-row-btn {
  min-height: var(--shd-touch-target);
  min-width: var(--shd-touch-target);
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--shd-accent);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--shd-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.shd-row-btn:active {
  background: var(--shd-accent);
  color: var(--shd-bg);
}


.shd-kiosk {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.shd-kiosk-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  min-height: 44px;                 
  background: var(--shd-surface);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.shd-kiosk-row span {
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.shd-kiosk-row b {
  color: var(--shd-text);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}




body,
.nr-dashboard-theme,
md-content {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--shd-bg) 0%, var(--shd-bg-2) 100%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}


body ui-card-panel,
body md-card {
  background: var(--shd-card);
  border-radius: 16px;
  
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) !important;
  box-shadow: none;
}

body ui-card-panel {
  padding: 16px;
}


h1,
.md-toolbar-tools h1 {
  font-size: 32px;
  line-height: 42px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--shd-text);
}

h2 { font-size: 28px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--shd-text); }
h3 { font-size: 22px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--shd-text); }
h4 { font-size: 22px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--shd-text); }


body .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 26px;
  font-weight: 600;
  
  color: var(--shd-accent-text) !important;
}


md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active {
  background: var(--shd-accent);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active,
body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active * {
  
  color: var(--shd-on-accent) !important;
}


body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active svg,
body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active path {
  fill: var(--shd-on-accent);
}


body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active button,
body md-list-item.nr-menu-item-active .md-button {
  border-right-color: transparent !important;
  border-right-width: 0 !important;
}



.shd-tiles-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  align-items: center;
}

.shd-search {
  flex: 1 1 180px;
  min-height: 44px;                 
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  background: var(--shd-surface);
  color: var(--shd-text);
  font-size: 15px;
}

.shd-search::placeholder { color: var(--shd-muted); }

.shd-chip {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  background: var(--shd-surface);
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.shd-chip.on {
  background: var(--shd-accent);
  border-color: var(--shd-accent);
  color: var(--shd-on-accent);
}

.shd-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); }


.shd-tile-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}

.shd-tile {
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.shd-tile-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}

.shd-tile-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  fill: var(--shd-muted);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.shd-tile-state {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 44px;
  min-width: 44px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.shd-tile-state:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.shd-tile-state[disabled] { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

.shd-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--shd-text-dim);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.shd-dot.live { background: var(--shd-ok); }

.shd-tile-name {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--shd-text);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shd-tiles-empty {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  padding: 18px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
}


.shd-tile.d-light        { background: rgba(250, 111,  99, 0.14); }
.shd-tile.d-light .shd-tile-icon        { fill: #fa6f63; }   
.shd-tile.d-switch       { background: rgba( 77, 208, 225, 0.14); }
.shd-tile.d-switch .shd-tile-icon       { fill: #4dd0e1; }   
.shd-tile.d-media_player { background: rgba(100, 181, 246, 0.14); }
.shd-tile.d-media_player .shd-tile-icon { fill: #64b5f6; }   
.shd-tile.d-cover        { background: rgba(126, 184, 255, 0.14); }
.shd-tile.d-cover .shd-tile-icon        { fill: #7eb8ff; }   
.shd-tile.d-lock         { background: rgba(255, 200,  87, 0.14); }
.shd-tile.d-lock .shd-tile-icon         { fill: #ffc857; }   


.shd-tile.on {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20);
}






.shd-activity-chart {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 240px;
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--shd-card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.shd-activity-chart canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}


.shd-activity-chart .chart-empty {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
}


.shd-recently-changed {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--shd-card);
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.shd-recently-changed h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--shd-text);
}

.shd-recently-changed .shd-rc-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.shd-recently-changed .shd-rc-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.shd-rc-icon {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.shd-rc-name {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--shd-text);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shd-rc-domain {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}


.shd-rc-domain.d-light        { background: rgba(250, 111,  99, 0.14); color: #fa6f63; }
.shd-rc-domain.d-switch       { background: rgba( 77, 208, 225, 0.14); color: #4dd0e1; }
.shd-rc-domain.d-media_player { background: rgba(100, 181, 246, 0.14); color: #64b5f6; }
.shd-rc-domain.d-cover        { background: rgba(126, 184, 255, 0.14); color: #7eb8ff; }
.shd-rc-domain.d-lock         { background: rgba(255, 200,  87, 0.14); color: #ffc857; }


.shd-now-playing {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 120px;
  border-radius: var(--shd-radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--shd-card);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

.shd-now-playing .np-content {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 12px;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.shd-now-playing .np-content.hidden {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.shd-now-playing .np-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--shd-text);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shd-now-playing .np-artist {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.shd-now-playing .np-progress {
  height: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.shd-now-playing .np-progress-bar {
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--shd-accent);
  border-radius: 2px;
  width: 0%;
  transition: width 0.3s linear;
}


.shd-now-playing .np-empty {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--shd-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  pointer-events: none;
}






/* Painted from the DERIVED token, not the palette token. This rule is
   specificity (0,1,1) and therefore BEATS the plain `body` rule in
   css/dashboard.css -- verified live: with only the body rule changed, the
   engine computed the right colour and the page still painted --shd-bg
   (measured body background rgb(26,26,46) instead of the night rgb(13,14,28)).
   js/background.js writes --shd-bg-effective; the fallback keeps the palette
   colour whenever the engine has not run. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme {
  background-color: var(--shd-bg-effective, var(--shd-bg));
  color: var(--shd-text);
  transition: background-color 0.8s ease;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   The dashboard's own theme block defines the --nr-dashboard-* variables
   but then PAINTS its primary surfaces with hardcoded colours that ignore
   them. Measured in dashboard 3.6.6 (selector -> colour):
     body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content md-card   -> #fff
     .nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel            -> #fff
     body.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar           -> #0094CE
     body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav           -> #eee
   Overriding only the variables therefore darkens :root while the page
   still renders light. These rules match or exceed each original's
   specificity, and this block is injected last, so ties resolve here.
   Deliberately not !important: nothing here is inline, and !important
   would also defeat the dashboard's later runtime theming.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content md-card {
  background: var(--shd-card);
  color: var(--shd-text);
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
  background: var(--shd-card);
  color: var(--shd-text);
}

/* The dashboard paints ui_template content on its OWN white panel:
     .nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template { background-color: #fff }
   That selector is specificity (0,2,0) and therefore BEATS the (0,1,3)
   `body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content md-card` rule above -- so templated
   widgets (the device and client tables) stayed white while the theme's
   `#eee` text sat on top of them. Measured contrast ratio: 1.16:1, i.e.
   invisible. Matching at (0,2,1) wins. Verified: the tables were the ONLY
   white surfaces left; every other widget card was already on --shd-card. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--shd-text);
}
/* The dashboard's legacy `.table` class is written for a light background.
   Its own rules only set borders/padding, so rows need explicit dark-theme
   separation or the list reads as one undifferentiated block. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme table.table {
  color: var(--shd-text);
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme table.table th {
  color: var(--shd-text);
  background: transparent;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--shd-accent);
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme table.table td {
  color: var(--shd-text);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme table.table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);   /* zebra striping for scanability */

/* `--shd-muted` is deliberately lighter than the 4.5:1 floor against
   --shd-card, so secondary text stays legible rather than decorative. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template .shd-muted,
body.nr-dashboard-theme .shd-muted {
  color: var(--shd-muted);
}
/* The slider's floating value bubble paints TEXT on the dashboard's hardcoded
   accent (--nr-dashboard-widgetBackgroundColor / #4FBAE4), which the theme's
   light text sat on at ~2.2:1 -- the number was barely legible. Give the
   bubble a dark surface. The track FILL keeps the accent: it is decorative
   and carries no text, so it is not a contrast problem. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-slider .md-sign,
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-slider .md-sign {

   beats it -- no !important needed. Setting the node's `valueFontColor` does
   NOT work here: the 3.6.6 ui_gauge controller never forwards it to justgage

   before: values 0/4.7/100 at ~1.4:1, effectively invisible on the dark card. */

  color: var(--shd-text);

body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav .md-button {

body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav .md-button {

  color: var(--shd-text);

/* Charts/gauge/template content the dashboard paints on its own light panel. */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card .nr-dashboard-text,
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card table,
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card th,
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card td {
  color: var(--shd-text);
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--shd-accent);
}

/* ==================================================================
   LANDSCAPE / WIDE-SCREEN LAYOUT
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   The dashboard's masonry JS writes INLINE pixel widths onto
   `.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer` (measured: width 318px for a width-12
   group -> ~53.3px per grid unit) and INLINE `left`/`top` onto
   `ui-card-panel`. It derives those from the group's `width` in grid
   units and ignores the viewport, so on a 2166px screen every tab is a
   ~320px column pinned near the centre and the rest of the screen is
   empty.

   Because the widths are INLINE they outrank any normal CSS rule, so
   `!important` is required here — this is the case it exists for. We
   then reflow the cards ourselves.

   `!important` cannot beat inline styles for `left` on the same
   element, so a group that sits right-of-centre would still be offset;
   `margin-left: auto` is therefore applied with `!important` too, and
   the panel is pinned with left/right as well. Measured before/after
   below in tests/test_theme_wiring.py. */

/* Any reasonably wide viewport: stop the dashboard pinning a fixed
   narrow column. */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    /* The panel carries inline left/top from the masonry layout. `auto` with
       !important neutralises them without introducing an offset of its own
       (`right` must NOT be set here: on a relatively-positioned box a non-auto
       `right` shifts the element left by its own width). */
    position: relative !important;
    left: auto !important;
    top: auto !important;
    margin-left: 0 !important;
    margin-right: 0 !important;
  }
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
  }
  /* The title bar carries an inline width matching the old fixed column. */
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
    width: auto !important;
  }
  /* Let the masonry container span the content area. */
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .masonry-container {
    width: 100% !important;
  }
  /* The widgets inside a card are `position: absolute` with an inline `top`
     (measured: top 0/54/108/216/324px), so the card had no height of its own
     and collapsed to 0 -- the panel then shrank to a 56px strip and the
     widgets, though still painted, were clipped out of the layout. Returning
     them to normal flow makes the container grow to fit.

     They are then laid out as a wrapping row rather than stretched to the full
     width: the dashboard sizes each widget's inline height for the ORIGINAL
     ~318px column, so stretching a widget to 2166px stretched its canvas to
     2144x221 (measured) -- a badly distorted, unreadable gauge. Content-sized
     cards that wrap into columns keep every widget at a sane aspect ratio and
     still fill the screen.

     `height` is deliberately left alone: gauges and charts depend on their
     dashboard-computed inline height to size the canvas. */
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer md-card,
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-card {
    position: static !important;
    left: auto !important;
    top: auto !important;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: top;
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 180px;
    margin: 8px 12px 12px 0;
  }
}

/* Genuinely wide screens (tablet landscape, desktop, wall panel). Every tab
   currently carries ONE group, so the panel fills the content width.
   NOTE: this block must NOT set a width on `md-card` -- the 900px block above
   already sizes widgets for their own aspect ratio, and an equal-specificity
   `width: 100% !important` here would win on source order and stretch every
   canvas again (measured: a gauge canvas blown out to 2144x221). */
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
    display: block;
    width: 100% !important;
  }
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .masonry-container {
    text-align: left;
  }
}

/* Short-and-wide (tablet held in landscape): trim vertical padding so
   more fits above the fold. */
@media (max-height: 600px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
    padding-top: 0;
  }
  body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}

</style><script>
/* shd-collapse-defaults: progressive disclosure (card t_b3218913).
   Groups configured with className 'shd-collapsible' start collapsed; the
   stock dashboard cannot do this itself (its localStorage key is shared by
   every panel). Collapse by clicking the group's own caret -- the identical
   code path the dashboard uses to restore a saved state -- so the caret icon
   and scope state stay in sync. */
(function () {
  if (window.__shdCollapseDefaults) { return; }
  window.__shdCollapseDefaults = true;
  var PREFIX = 'shd_collapsed_';
  var SHARED_KEY = '{{group.header.id}}';  /* the stock key: same literal text
     for every panel (interpolation is unresolved at link time) */

  function groupKey(host) {
    var id = host.getAttribute('node-id') || '';
    // Before interpolation resolves, the attribute holds the raw {{...}} text.
    return id && id.indexOf('{') === -1 ? PREFIX + id : null;
  }

  function scrubShared() {
    /* Our click made the stock write the shared key; if it is ever read at
       link time again, EVERY panel auto-collapses on load. It must never
       decide anything. */
    try { localStorage.removeItem(SHARED_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function armCarat(host, carat) {
    // Record the user's toggle in OUR namespace so choices survive reloads.
    if (!carat || carat.getAttribute('data-shd-armed')) { return; }
    carat.setAttribute('data-shd-armed', '1');
    carat.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var k = groupKey(host);
      if (k) {
        var cur = null;
        try { cur = localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) {}
        /* The click always TOGGLES, so the new state is the inverse of the
           recorded one: 'false' (open) -> 'true'; anything else -> 'false'.
           A null record means the panel was collapsed-by-default, so the
           click opened it. */
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(k, cur === 'false' ? 'true' : 'false');
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      scrubShared();
    });
  }

  function armTitleBar(inner, host, carat) {
    /* The stock binds ng-click on the CARAT SPAN ONLY -- a ~14x14px tap
       target. The theme CSS enlarges the caret to the touch target and
       makes the whole title <p> a 44px-high flex row; forward taps anywhere
       on the row to the caret so the toggle area spans the full group
       width (acceptance: touch-friendly expand/collapse). */
    var title = inner.querySelector('.nr-dashboard-cardtitle');
    if (!title || title.getAttribute('data-shd-armed')) { return; }
    title.setAttribute('data-shd-armed', '1');
    title.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (carat.contains(e.target)) { return; }  /* direct carat tap: the
        carat's own ng-click + our carat listener already handled it */
      carat.click();
    });
  }

  function applyDefaults() {
    /* className lives on the INNER .nr-dashboard-cardpanel div (ng-class in
       the stock template) -- never on the <ui-card-panel> host. */
    var inners = document.querySelectorAll(
        '.nr-dashboard-cardpanel.shd-collapsible');
    for (var i = 0; i < inners.length; i++) {
      var inner = inners[i];
      var host = inner.parentNode;             /* <ui-card-panel node-id=...> */
      var carat = inner.querySelector('.nr-dashboard-cardcarat');
      var container = inner.querySelector('.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer');
      if (!host || host.nodeType !== 1 || !carat || !container) { continue; }

      var k = groupKey(host);
      if (!k) { continue; }                    /* id not interpolated yet */

      // One action per render: a second click during the 150ms slideToggle
      // animation would flip the panel back the other way. The marker dies
      // with the panel element when the tab re-renders.
      var done = host.getAttribute('data-shd-done');
      if (!done) {
        var stored = null;
        try { stored = localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) {}
        var isCollapsed = container.offsetParent === null;
        var act = false;
        if (stored === 'false') {
          act = isCollapsed;      /* user pinned OPEN; the stock shared-key
             restore may have collapsed it anyway -> re-open */
        } else if (stored === 'true') {
          act = !isCollapsed;     /* user pinned CLOSED; keep it closed */
        } else {
          act = !isCollapsed;     /* fresh visit: default-collapsed */
        }
        if (act) {
          carat.click();
          scrubShared();
          host.setAttribute('data-shd-done', '1');
        }
      }
      // Arm AFTER any programmatic click so our own click is never recorded
      // as a user choice; both arms are idempotent per panel render.
      armCarat(host, carat);
      armTitleBar(inner, host, carat);
    }
  }

  var scheduled = false;
  function schedule() {
    if (scheduled) { return; }
    scheduled = true;
    setTimeout(function () { scheduled = false; applyDefaults(); }, 100);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyDefaults);
  } else {
    applyDefaults();
  }
  setTimeout(applyDefaults, 500);
  setTimeout(applyDefaults, 1500);
  var observer = new MutationObserver(function (muts) {
    for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
      if (muts[i].addedNodes.length) { schedule(); return; }
    }
  });
  if (document.body) {
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  } else {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ============================================================================
   Smart Home Dashboard -- Theme Manager (task t_2fd8fb10)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Palettes map EVERY colour token declared in css/dashboard.css :root to a
   concrete value. The runtime manager applies a palette by setting the CSS
   custom properties on document.documentElement -- no stylesheet swap, no
   page reload, no layout shift (only colour properties are touched; the
   non-colour tokens --shd-touch-target / --shd-radius are never overridden).

   HOW THIS FILE IS DEPLOYED (important for anyone editing it):
   The dashboard serves no static assets (httpStatic is unset), so js/themes.js
   is NOT loaded by the browser as a file. tools/gen_flows.py INLINES this file
   into a global-scope ui_template ("Theme manager", hidden Theme tab) that the
   dashboard appends to <head>; its inline script executes on load -- the same
   mechanism the mobile theme's <style> block already uses. The generator also
   parses the palette ids/labels out of THIS file to build the Settings-tab
   picker buttons and the "Set theme" validator, so the UI can never drift from
   the palettes actually shipped. Regenerate flows after editing:
       python3 tools/gen_flows.py     (CI re-runs it and diffs flows/)

   SWITCHING CHANNELS (both verified against the node-red-dashboard 3.6.6
   server/client sources):
   - Pick a palette: Settings tab buttons -> "Set theme" function -> this
     module's apply(), broadcast over the dashboard socket to every client.
   - Programmatic: any Node-RED msg with msg.payload = palette id wired into
     the "Set theme" function node switches the theme the same way.
   The "Set theme" node deletes msg.socketid before emitting -- ui.js
   emitSocket() would otherwise deliver the change only to the browser that
   clicked the button.

   PERSISTENCE: apply() writes localStorage, so a refresh re-applies the
   chosen palette during boot (below) with no flash of the wrong theme. The
   "Set theme" function ALSO records the palette id in flow context, and an
   inject re-pushes it on deploy so every connected client re-syncs after a
   Node-RED restart.

   COLOUR SOURCES: the only colour definitions in this repository are (a) the
   :root block in css/dashboard.css -- the default palette -- and (b) the
   palettes in this module. Applying 'default' REMOVES the inline overrides so
   the stylesheet wins again, which makes stale-default drift structurally
   impossible; tests/test_theme_manager.py additionally asserts the 'default'
   palette mirrors :root exactly and that every palette clears the WCAG floors.
   ============================================================================ */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- palettes */

  /* Token order mirrors css/dashboard.css :root. Colour values were checked
     --shd-accent-text is the TEXT-role accent (group headings, widget titles);
     --shd-accent stays decorative/gradient. Every TEXT token below clears
     WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) on bg/surface/card -- there is no relaxed 3:1 tier for
     text any more, because a 3:1 accent was exactly how group headings shipped
     at 3.84:1. tests/test_theme_manager.py recomputes the ratios
     from these definitions, so a below-floor palette fails CI. */
  var THEMES = {
    'default': {
      label: 'Midnight (default)',
      tokens: {
        '--shd-bg':        '#0b1420',
        '--shd-bg-2':      '#0e1a26',
        '--shd-surface':   '#16263c',
        '--shd-card':      '#243a54',
        '--shd-accent':    '#fa6f63',
        '--shd-accent-2':  '#764ba2',
        '--shd-accent-text': '#ff9a91',
        '--shd-on-accent': '#0b1420',
        '--shd-text':      '#eef3f8',
        '--shd-muted':     '#9fb0c6',
        '--shd-text-dim':  '#95a5b8',
        '--shd-ok':        '#2ecc71',
        '--shd-warn':      '#f1c40f',
        '--shd-err':       '#ff8a8a'
      }
    },
    'nord': {
      label: 'Nord',
      tokens: {
        '--shd-bg':        '#2e3440',
        '--shd-bg-2':      '#2a3038',
        '--shd-surface':   '#3b4252',
        '--shd-card':      '#434c5e',
        '--shd-accent':    '#88c0d0',
        '--shd-accent-2':  '#5e81ac',
        '--shd-accent-text': '#a8dae8',
        '--shd-on-accent': '#2e3440',
        '--shd-text':      '#eceff4',
        '--shd-muted':     '#d8dee9',
        '--shd-text-dim':  '#c0c9d8',
        '--shd-ok':        '#b9d49e',
        '--shd-warn':      '#ebcb8b',
        '--shd-err':       '#f7b1bd'
      }
    },
    'cyberpunk': {
      label: 'Cyberpunk',
      tokens: {
        '--shd-bg':        '#0d0221',
        '--shd-bg-2':      '#12032c',
        '--shd-surface':   '#190b33',
        '--shd-card':      '#26123f',
        '--shd-accent':    '#00f0ff',
        '--shd-accent-2':  '#ff2a6d',
        '--shd-accent-text': '#00f0ff',
        '--shd-on-accent': '#0d0221',
        '--shd-text':      '#f0eaff',
        '--shd-muted':     '#c9b8ff',
        '--shd-text-dim':  '#b8a8e0',
        '--shd-ok':        '#05ffa1',
        '--shd-warn':      '#fcee0a',
        '--shd-err':       '#ff2a6d'
      }
    }
  };

  var STORAGE_KEY = 'shd_theme';

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime */

  function normaliseId(id) {
    if (typeof id !== 'string') { return null; }
    var key = id.trim().toLowerCase();
    return THEMES.hasOwnProperty(key) ? key : null;
  }

  /* Apply every token of a palette onto the document root. Returns the
     applied palette id, or null for an unknown palette.

     'default' REMOVES the inline overrides instead of writing values, so the
     :root block in css/dashboard.css is the single source of the default
     colours and the shipped stylesheet always wins when "default" is active. */
  function applyTheme(id) {
    var key = normaliseId(id);
    if (!key) { return null; }
    var root = global.document && global.document.documentElement;
    if (!root) { return null; }
    var tokens = THEMES[key].tokens;
    for (var name in tokens) {
      if (tokens.hasOwnProperty(name)) {
        if (key === 'default') {
          root.style.removeProperty(name);
        } else {
          root.style.setProperty(name, tokens[name]);
        }
      }
    }
    try { global.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, key); } catch (e) { /* private mode */ }
    return key;
  }

  /* Apply the stored (or default) palette at boot. The generator places this
     call in the global head template, which the dashboard appends to <head>
     during connect -- before the tab content renders -- so the correct palette
     is already active at first paint: no flash of the wrong theme. */
  function initTheme() {
    var stored = null;
    try { stored = global.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (e) { /* private mode */ }
    return applyTheme(stored || 'default');
  }

  global.SHD_THEMES = THEMES;
  global.SHDThemeManager = {
    apply: applyTheme,
    init: initTheme,
    list: function () {
      var out = [];
      for (var k in THEMES) {
        if (THEMES.hasOwnProperty(k)) { out.push({ id: k, label: THEMES[k].label }); }
      }
      return out;
    },
    current: function () {
      try { return global.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'default'; }
      catch (e) { return 'default'; }
    }
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
SHDThemeManager.init();
/* ==========================================================================
   Dynamic Background Engine  (card t_8b8679a9)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Ambient background that follows BOTH the time of day and system state.

   WHY IT WRITES ONE DERIVED TOKEN INSTEAD OF --shd-bg
   ---------------------------------------------------
   The Theme Manager (js/themes.js) owns --shd-bg: it is the palette's base
   colour, and applyTheme() rewrites it on every switch. If this engine also
   wrote --shd-bg the two would fight, and whichever ran last would win -- a
   theme switch would silently cancel the night state (or vice versa).

   So this engine computes  --shd-bg-effective  = palette --shd-bg COMPOSITED
   with the current state tint, and CSS paints `body` from that with --shd-bg
   as the fallback:

       body.nr-dashboard-theme {
         background-color: var(--shd-bg-effective, var(--shd-bg));
       }

   Consequences: switching palette immediately re-derives the effective colour
   (no cancellation), and the state tint survives theme changes. Only ONE
   custom property changes per transition -- no layout, no reflow, no FOUC.
   The smoothness comes from a background-color transition in CSS, which the
   compositor handles; @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) turns it off.

   TWO INDEPENDENT TRIGGERS (both required by the card)
   ---------------------------------------------------
   1. TIME   -- setInterval every 30s recomputes the period. Cheap: a Date
                read plus at most one style write when the period changed.
   2. STATE  -- SHDBackground.setSeverity('critical'|'warning'|'ok') from the
                alert banners. A state override holds for OVERRIDE_MS, then
                decays back to the time-of-day state on the next tick, so one
                bad reading cannot tint the screen forever.

   Deliberately dependency-free and idempotent: the dashboard tears down and
   re-appends global head templates on every (re)connect, so init() may run
   many times. Only one interval is ever kept.
   ========================================================================== */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  /* Ambient tints, composited OVER the palette background. Alpha is the whole
     point: 0 means "hand the palette colour back untouched" (daytime). */
  var PERIOD_TINTS = {
    night: 'rgba(2, 4, 14, 0.55)',      /* 22:00-06:00  deep, low-glare      */
    dawn:  'rgba(60, 32, 12, 0.30)',    /* 06:00-08:00  warm, waking         */
    day:   'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)',          /* 08:00-17:00  palette as authored  */
    dusk:  'rgba(56, 20, 44, 0.35)'     /* 17:00-22:00  warm, winding down   */
  };

  /* State overrides. Critical is a red wash strong enough to be noticed on a
     wall panel without making card text unreadable. */
  var SEVERITY_TINTS = {
    critical: 'rgba(120, 10, 10, 0.45)',
    warning:  'rgba(120, 80, 0, 0.28)',
    ok:       ''
  };

  var OVERRIDE_MS = 60000;   /* a state override decays after 60s */
  var TICK_MS = 30000;       /* time-based recompute cadence */

  var state = { period: null, severity: 'ok', overrideUntil: 0, timer: null };

  function periodForHour(h) {
    if (h >= 22 || h < 6) { return 'night'; }
    if (h < 8) { return 'dawn'; }
    if (h < 17) { return 'day'; }
    return 'dusk';
  }

  function parseColor(str) {
    if (!str) { return null; }
    var s = String(str).trim();
    var m = s.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i);
    if (m) {
      var h = m[1];
      if (h.length === 3) { h = h[0] + h[0] + h[1] + h[1] + h[2] + h[2]; }
      return [parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16),
              parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16), 1];
    }
    var r = s.match(/^rgba?\(([^)]+)\)$/i);
    if (r) {
      var p = r[1].split(',').map(function (v) { return parseFloat(v); });
      return [p[0], p[1], p[2], p.length > 3 ? p[3] : 1];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* Composite `over` (with its alpha) onto `base`. Returns rgb()/rgba(). */
  function composite(base, over) {
    var b = parseColor(base);
    var o = parseColor(over);
    if (!o || !o[3]) { return base; }            /* nothing to apply */
    if (!b) { return over; }                     /* no palette: tint alone */
    var a = o[3];
    var mix = [
      Math.round(o[0] * a + b[0] * (1 - a)),
      Math.round(o[1] * a + b[1] * (1 - a)),
      Math.round(o[2] * a + b[2] * (1 - a))
    ];
    return 'rgb(' + mix[0] + ', ' + mix[1] + ', ' + mix[2] + ')';
  }

  function paletteBg() {
    var v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--shd-bg');
    v = (v || '').trim();
    if (v) { return v; }
    /* No literal colour here on purpose. A hardcoded hex fallback becomes a
       stale palette value the moment the palette changes -- and it tripped
       tests/test_theme_manager.py's "manager template carries non-palette
       colour" guard when the P0 palette landed. Ask the document instead: it is
       already painted from the same token, so it cannot drift. */
    return getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor || 'rgb(0, 0, 0)';
  }

  function activeSeverity() {
    if (state.severity !== 'ok' && Date.now() > state.overrideUntil) {
      return 'ok';                                /* override expired */
    }
    return state.severity;
  }

  /* The single writer. One custom property, only when the value changes. */
  function apply(force) {
    var sev = activeSeverity();
    var period = periodForHour(new Date().getHours());
    var tint = SEVERITY_TINTS[sev] || PERIOD_TINTS[period] || '';

    /* A severity tint wins while it is active; otherwise time of day rules. */
    if (!tint) { tint = PERIOD_TINTS[period] || ''; }

    var effective = tint ? composite(paletteBg(), tint) : paletteBg();
    var root = document.documentElement;
    if (force || root.style.getPropertyValue('--shd-bg-effective') !== effective) {
      root.style.setProperty('--shd-bg-effective', effective);
    }
    state.period = period;
    return { period: period, severity: sev, effective: effective };
  }

  function tick() { apply(false); }

  function start() {
    apply(true);
    if (state.timer) { clearInterval(state.timer); }  /* idempotent re-init */
    state.timer = setInterval(tick, TICK_MS);
  }

  /* PUBLIC API ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  global.SHDBackground = {
    /* Called by every tab's alert banner with its computed severity. */
    setSeverity: function (sev) {
      var s = String(sev || 'ok');
      if (!SEVERITY_TINTS.hasOwnProperty(s)) { s = 'ok'; }
      state.severity = s;
      state.overrideUntil = Date.now() + OVERRIDE_MS;
      return apply(false);
    },
    /* Force a recompute (tests, theme switches, manual refresh). */
    refreshNow: function () { return apply(true); },
    getState: function () {
      return { period: state.period, severity: activeSeverity(),
               effective: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
                 .getPropertyValue('--shd-bg-effective').trim() };
    },
    periods: Object.keys(PERIOD_TINTS),
    init: start
  };

  start();
})(window);
